lesson.description: Lesson is the lesson's ID: its first slide's data-id.

language.description: Language is the narration's BCP-47 language.

audio.description: Audio is the MP3 file, relative to the recordings directory.

captions.description: Captions is a WebVTT file, relative to the recordings directory.

voice.description: Voice is the voice it was recorded with.

slides.description:
Slides are the lesson's slides in order, with where each one's
narration starts in the audio.

LessonRecording.description: LessonRecording is one lesson's narration recorded in one language.

startMs.description: StartMs is where the slide's narration starts in the audio.

durationMs.description: DurationMs covers the slide's speech and its pause.

narration.description: Narration is the NarrationFingerprint of the narration recorded.

RecordedSlide.description: RecordedSlide is one slide's place in a lesson recording.

provider.description: Provider is the TTS provider, such as elevenlabs.

voiceId.description: VoiceID is the provider's voice ID.

name.description: Name is the voice's display name.

RecordingVoice.description: RecordingVoice describes the voice a recording was made with.

lessons.description: Lessons has one entry per lesson and language.

title: course-spec deck recordings
description: Recordings is a deck's recorded narration: recordings/recordings.json.
